title: finding(app-shell,plugin-designer,a11y): three more forms put a bare required `*` inside the control's label (ScreenView, metadata-admin SchemaForm, AppCreationWizard), so it is read as part of the name and the requirement is never exposed as a state
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a named probe. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The sites are `packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` and `packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx`.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10178 (PR objectui#10361), which fixed the same shape on the console's `FormPage`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect: the objectui#10178 shape in three more forms

A visual required marker (`*`) sits inside the `label` associated with the control and is not `aria-hidden`. Assistive technology reads it as part of the control's name ("Title *"), and in each site the requirement itself is never exposed as a state. The rule already exists: `ActionParamDialog` marks its `*` `aria-hidden="true"` ("Visual-only", objectui#3299), and objectui#10361 applies it to `FormPage`.

| site | reading on `origin/main` (by content, not line numbers) |
|:--|:--|
| `ScreenView.tsx` (flow screen fields) | A bare `*` span sits inside `Label htmlFor=ff-NAME`. `ScreenFieldInput` gives every control (Input, Textarea, Checkbox, SelectTrigger) the id `ff-NAME`, with no `required` or `aria-required` |
| `metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` | The `showRequiredStar` span, in both the boolean row and the default row, has no `aria-hidden` and sits inside the label associated by `htmlFor`, or by id plus `aria-labelledby`. The repeater's column-header `th`, which every cell control references through `aria-labelledby`, carries the same bare `*`. The file has no `aria-required` |
| `AppCreationWizard.tsx` | The App name and App title labels (`htmlFor` `app-name` / `app-title`) carry a bare `*` span. The inputs have no `required` or `aria-required` |

## Evidence

The dev read these sites in code; this seat confirmed the `SchemaForm` `showRequiredStar` span and the wizard's `app-name` / `app-title` labels on `origin/main`. ⚠️ No site was rendered: the defect class was measured on `FormPage` (happy-dom and Chromium's accessibility tree) and is inferred for these three from the same DOM shape.

Named probes, one per site:
- Render `ScreenView` with a required text field: `getByRole('textbox', { name: LABEL })` misses.
- Render `SchemaForm` with a required string property: the control's computed name ends in `*`.
- Render the wizard's basic step: `getByRole('textbox', { name: APP_NAME_LABEL })` misses.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The fix per site is the objectui#10361 shape: `aria-hidden="true"` on the marker, and `aria-required` on controls that expose no required state. Where native `required` would change submit behaviour (a checkbox, a form without `noValidate`), use `aria-required`, as objectui#10361 measured.
- The sites are in two packages. Triage may split them or keep one card.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `ScreenView … (required|asterisk|aria)`, `SchemaForm … (required|star|asterisk)` or `AppCreationWizard … (required|asterisk)` ⇒ 0 hits. Control pattern `required marker` ⇒ objectui#10178, the must-hit control, which did hit.

Dedupe words: `ScreenView required asterisk accessible name` · `SchemaForm required star accessible name` · `AppCreationWizard required asterisk label` · `screen flow field aria-required missing`
